items.title: Alice Zeno Interview, 1960-01-25
items.q: William. I like William. Alice William.

ctx.x: But I wanted to get your full name. How do you spell your name? Is it the different French spelling?
Alice. Alice. A-L-I-C-E. Same as English. William. I like William. Alice William.
And the Zeno, does that have an N on the N? Is it Z-E-N-O?
